title: Bundesrichtlinie Kernprozess „Unternehmen unterstützen“ (SFU/2-2026, GZ BGS/SFU/0602/6264/2026), gültig ab 01.09.2026
title_en: Federal guideline, core process 'Supporting enterprises' (employer service): 103 pages; section 6.1.4.2 employment of third-country nationals, section 9.2.1 replacement-worker procedure (labour-market test, §§ 4(1) and 4b AuslBG), handling of AuslBG violations and of temporary-work agencies as customers
note: signed 1 July 2026; replaces SFU/1-2026 (in force from 2 March 2026, no longer on the site); listed at https://www.ams.at/organisation/kontaktmoeglichkeiten/informationsfreiheit-ams

title: Bundesrichtlinie Kernprozess Arbeitskräfte unterstützen, gültig ab 01.07.2025
title_en: Federal guideline, core process 'Supporting workers' (jobseeker service): 146 pages; registration of third-country nationals as jobseekers, placement rules for foreigners without free labour-market access (no placement with temporary-work agencies, § 4(1) no. 7 AuslBG)
